res.description:
As a lead on the Design Systems & Structures team, you will set the strategic direction for content design systems and formats across Services lines of business, partner closely with cross-functional teams, and bring a rigorous, human-centered approach to building scalable frameworks that uphold Apple's standards of quality and craft.
Description
- Lead the design, development, and evolution of content design systems used across Apple Services
- Define and operationalize cohesive content structures that reflect Apple's signature voice, style, and experience principles
- Leverage AI tools, design tools, and emerging technologies to advance the efficiency and quality of content design at scale
- Partner with design, engineering, product, and business teams to ensure systems are adopted, maintained, and continuously improved
- Support the exploration and development of new content formats across Services
- Mentor and guide IC designers, raising the craft and capability of the team
- Synthesize complex, cross-functional requirements into clear, elegant design system solutions
res.minimumQualifications:
12+ years of experience in human interface design, content design and UX design
Demonstrated experience leading owning design systems work in a large, complex organization
Expert-level proficiency in design tools (Sketch, CS Suite and Figma). Prototyping skills are beneficial.
Experience working across multiple products and lines of business simultaneously
Strong understanding of content strategy, information architecture, and editorial standards
res.preferredQualifications:
Experience in a consumer technology, media and services environment
Familiarity with AI-assisted content and design workflows
Experience developing new content formats and pioneering design system standards from the ground up
Prior experience mentoring and managing designers

en_US.name: Pay & Benefits
en_US.content:
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

res.description: As the Noise and Vibration EPM you will be the central voice representing the needs of not only the team but the customer expectation. You will be critical in driving complex multi-physics noise issue
res.minimumQualifications:
BSME or BSEE or equivalent 
4+ years of experience in project management 
Excellent communication, organizational and leadership skills
Ability to filter and distill relevant information for the right audience
Understand technical issues and drive them to closure by bringing together key partners for decision making
Ability to travel internationally when needed(<10%)

Strong technical background in EE or ME or NVH. Masters in Engineering is a plus
Technical hands on experience with any of the following: System Dynamics, Mechanical Noise, Electrical Noise, or Fan Noise
Experience working with OEM/ODM partners
